Only 6 albums in AOTY's top 100 of 2026 have passed 13,000 user ratings, and the most-rated one beat Olivia Rodrigo by just 63. 🗳️

On albumoftheyear.org, underscores' "U" (released March 20) leads with 21,067 user ratings and a score of 83. Olivia Rodrigo's "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love" (June 12) is right behind at 21,004 (also 83), then Slayyyter's "WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA" at 19,899 (83), J. Cole's "The Fall-Off" at 17,350 (80), Gorillaz's "The Mountain" at 14,062 (80) and Denzel Curry & Kenneth Blume's "ii" at 13,332 (84).

Right behind them: Phoebe Bridgers' "Lost Weekend" (84, 11,934 ratings) and Vince Staples' "Cry Baby" (80, 11,859). Denzel Curry & Kenneth Blume's "ii" and Phoebe Bridgers' "Lost Weekend" have the highest score of any 2026 album with 10,000+ ratings: 84.

Put it in context: underscores has about 2M monthly listeners on Spotify, while Olivia Rodrigo has 67.5M. Ratings measure how many people sat down and voted, not how many stream, so the two lists look very different.

Which one is your album of the year so far? 👇

Data: albumoftheyear.org user scores and rating counts (the 100 highest-rated 2026 albums) + Spotify monthly listeners · Oct 15, 2026
